usage: Study dual-image blends, alpha choices, aspect handling and transition effects in local source. No shader source copied.
modifications: Reuse the project's validated premultiplied additive DrawList path and AspectFit instead of duplicating TiXL HLSL constants/samplers and straight-alpha blend modes.
Use complementary UNORM8 weights into one SDR target. Backend-wide texture/pass budgets remain unchanged.
Reuse PackageLoader and PreparedPackage for bounded FIFO preparation, cancellation and move-only host handoff. No second loader, render backend or device is introduced.
